findings.rationale: The jump security group permits TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing an administrative shell service directly to the internet.
The escalation role uses an unrestricted principal and receives the AdministratorAccess attachment, allowing broad privileges to be assumed beyond a least-privilege boundary.
The connectivity graph links the internet-reachable jump security group to the role escalation node through sts:AssumeRole, forming a direct exposure-to-identity escalation path.
The overbroad IAM statement is coupled with the S3 bucket public-read ACL, compounding wildcard identity permissions into externally exposed object access.
